scope: Whole-Sinnoh missing-area encounter audit — Route 205 North, Ravaged Path, Old Chateau, Snowpoint Temple, Routes 219-221 / Pal Park approach
design_source: Pokemon Platinum / Sinnoh, expanded for Mercury Redux
source_rule: Platinum/Sinnoh is the content source. Internal engine identifiers are implementation-only and do not define geography, ecology, or encounter design.

ROUTE_205_NORTH.identity: Platinum north half: Bidoof/Budew/Wurmple/Silcoon/Cascoon/Kricketot with rare Beautifly/Dustox; Mercury adds a forest-edge riverside layer without replacing those anchors.
ROUTE_205_NORTH.special_normalization: Platinum Poké Radar Slowpoke is folded into the normal authored pool. GBA cartridge-insertion Lotad is not used as a source mechanic.

RAVAGED_PATH.identity: Small Platinum Route 204 cave. Current Mercury land roster remains anchored by Zubat/Psyduck and expanded cave species; missing Surf/fishing ecology is restored from Platinum structure.

OLD_CHATEAU.identity: Platinum haunted mansion where ordinary wild encounters are Gastly-only; Mercury retains Gastly as the dominant anchor and expands with fitting Ghost species while preserving the manor as a special haunted location.

rotom.respawn: Next night / on re-entry after date rollover if KO or fled

OLD_CHATEAU.secret_key_policy: Rotom form appliances/Secret Key become an in-game unlock after the Old Chateau encounter; no external distribution requirement.

SNOWPOINT_TEMPLE.identity: Platinum temple retains Golbat/Sneasel plus Smoochum on 1F and Jynx on deeper floors; Mercury diversifies the frozen temple gradually without replacing those anchors.

regigigas.requirement: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel in party
regigigas.pre_league_policy: Temple entry and Regigigas encounter must not require National Dex or Hall of Fame once the three Regis are obtainable.

ROUTE_219.identity: Platinum small beach route south of Sandgem: no land grass, Surf/fishing only, anchored by Tentacool/Wingull/Tentacruel/Pelipper.

ROUTE_220.identity: Platinum open sea route with small islands. Keeps the Route 219 coastal anchors but shifts toward deeper-water species and stronger fishing targets.

ROUTE_221.identity: Platinum wooded Pal Park approach anchored by Sudowoodo/Girafarig/Roselia/Floatzel. Radar Nidorina/Nidorino and swarm Farfetchd are normalized into authored encounters instead of special RNG.

PAL_PARK.identity: Preserve Platinum Pal Park as a special facility rather than inventing a normal grass table. Mercury can later repurpose its migration function, but ordinary route-style encounters are intentionally absent.

remaining_audit_flags: Regirock/Regice/Registeel pre-League access still needs a dedicated Platinum-ruins policy. Registeel Iron Ruins is already reserved on Iron Island; Iceberg Ruins is in Mt. Coronet; Rock Peak Ruins is normally on postgame Route 228 and needs a Mercury pre-League access solution without using external-event Regigigas.
Battle Zone / Routes 225-230 have not been part of the main pre-League encounter pass. No required species may depend on those postgame routes.
